title: Aspirin for Prevention of Venous Thromboembolism Among Ovarian Cancer Patients Receiving Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy

sections.abstract:
This is a pilot study to determine the safety and efficacy of low dose aspirin for the prevention of venous thromboembolism among women with advanced ovarian cancer receiving neoadjuvant chemotherapy.

Posted outcomes: Number of Participants Experiencing a Venous Thromboembolism. timeframe=Up to six months. Aspirin=4
